order: Address five findings turned up in this round's review of the round-two code, while confirming that every round-one and round-two closure still holds. The reserve gate must evaluate the requested rung instead of a recast rung, so a degradation recast never silently satisfies a stop condition; disclose restrictions on every turn served through a fallback path. Replace the collapsed regular-expression glob matcher with a token-based dynamic-programming matcher, since separated wildcard runs broke the collapsed regex. Run output redaction before tail truncation only, so straddling credentials cannot leak a partial suffix. Install the trappable signal set on Windows, where one termination signal is untrappable, and document startup pruning as the recovery path there. Remove every literal NUL byte left in the router source. Also exempt record documents from a lint by filename prefix, and separate a review-lane test case from interference by a genuine external tool installation on the host machine. Put that verdict into the roster without changing a word.
claims: The reserve gate now evaluates the requested rung so a degradation recast never silently satisfies a stop, with restrictions disclosed on every fallback-served turn; glob matching moved to a token-based matcher after the collapsed regex broke on separated wildcard runs; redaction now runs before tail truncation; Windows installs the trappable signal set, with startup pruning documented as the recovery path there; and the stray NUL bytes are gone from the router source. The roster now holds that verdict, unaltered. Verifier finished at 92 passed. Registry and router stayed clean on this run too.
